title: Contoso firewall cutover sync
notes: Synthetic meeting spoken by Windows TTS voices. 'You' is on the mic track; Dana and Mark are remote (system track).

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Okay, looks like everyone is here. Thanks for joining. The main thing today is the firewall cutover for Contoso and the VPN profile changes.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Sounds good. Quick update from my side. We moved the remaining firewall rules into the new policy on Thursday, and the test traffic looked clean.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Did that include the rules for the warehouse scanners? Those were the ones that broke last time.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Yes, I added them as a separate group. I also tagged them so we can find them faster if something goes wrong.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. So what is left before we can schedule the cutover?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Two things. First, the VPN profiles still point at the old gateway. Second, we need someone on site in case the internet circuit does not come back cleanly.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I can push the new VPN profile through the management tool on Wednesday. Mark, can you confirm who is on site?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I will check with the office manager tomorrow morning and send you a name by noon.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: One more risk. The backup internet line is slower than we thought. If the main circuit fails during the change, video calls will be rough.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Let's call that out in the change notice so nobody is surprised. Dana, can you draft the notice?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Sure. I will have a draft by Tuesday end of day.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: What time are we thinking for the cutover itself? Friday night still?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Friday at eight in the evening. That gives us the whole weekend to roll back if we need to.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Friday evening works for me. I will be online the whole time.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Same here. I will bring the console cable just in case we lose remote access.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Perfect. Anything else we should cover?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Just the license renewal. The firewall support contract expires at the end of next month.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I thought finance already approved that.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: They approved the budget, but nobody has placed the order yet.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I will follow up with finance and get the order placed this week.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Thanks. That would save us a headache in December.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Okay, to recap. Dana drafts the change notice by Tuesday. I push the VPN profiles on Wednesday and handle the license order. Mark confirms the on site contact by noon tomorrow. The cutover is Friday evening.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Sounds right to me.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Works for me. Talk to you all on Friday.
